newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Germany-Morocco sign $76 million loan accords.
newsitem.headline: Germany-Morocco sign $76 million loan accords.

text.p: Morocco and German representatives signed agreements on Friday for a total of 118.2 million marks ($76 million) loans to the North African country.

German Ambassador Herwig Bartels and Moroccan Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj signed a 65 million mark agreement aimed at financing drinking water and environmental projects, a German embassy spokesman said.
"The first 10 years will be interest-free, and the next 30 years at two percent," he said.

Kabbaj and Doris Kohn, representative of Kreditanstalt fur Wiederaufbau, signed a second agreement for two loans totalling 53.2 million marks ($34.5 million) for irrigation projects. Details on these loans were not immediately available.
